intent: A black footer whose giant wordmark is a 2D-canvas field of mono characters sampled from the rasterised word. The cursor is a lens that scrambles, brightens and thickens the glyphs under it.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with container queries
stack.animation: requestAnimationFrame on canvas 2D; motion/react for the top-row entrance only
stack.rendering: offscreen raster + glyph atlas + cached base layer

layout.root: footer @container, bg black, overflow hidden; content max-w 1440px, gutters 20/40px
layout.topRow: white/8% top border; kicker + 17px sign-off (max 34ch) left, compact link row right at @4xl; stacked below; links in a 3-col grid of 44px targets below @lg
layout.canvas: full footer width; ink aligned to the content column via an invisible measuring copy; dot field edge to edge
layout.stacked: below 560px draw ['field','note'] as two lines with a 1-row gap
layout.legalRow: mono 11px uppercase white/40 legal + links; right-aligned hint with a 6px accent dot

wordmarkRaster.fit: pixel-scanned ink box scaled to the column width

motion.lens: radius clamp(width×0.085, 84, 150)px; position lerp 0.22; strength in 0.12 / out 0.07; f=(1−d²/R²)²; density v+f(0.3+0.55v); alpha +0.4f; scramble probability f^1.3×0.85 at ~9Hz per-cell phase; accent when f>0.45 on ink
motion.shimmer: every 10s a slanted Gaussian band (6% of columns wide) crosses the ink over 6.5s, +0.28 alpha, rare glyph flips; suppressed while the lens is active
motion.reveal: once per block at 25% visible on a shared clock; field slot 300ms: canvas blank until then, then a noisy left-to-right resolve over 1.0s, ease-out cubic; cells scramble (accent at the leading edge) just before landing; lens and shimmer only after
motion.topRow: rule draws (scaleX 800ms); kicker 60ms, sign-off 120ms, links from 200ms 35ms apart; each rises 12px out of an 8px blur over 600ms
motion.performance: base layer cached; only lens/shimmer cells redrawn; DPR cap 2; IntersectionObserver pause at 15%; paused in hidden tabs; rebuild on width change
motion.reducedMotion: single static frame; no lens, shimmer or sweep; text fades 150ms; hint hidden
motion.legalBar: slot 600ms, lands last: legal line, links 50ms apart, hint, then its accent dot pops

responsive.mobile: stacked two-line wordmark below 560px; 44px link targets; touch lens with pan-y

accessibility: canvas role=img with a descriptive aria-label
links in a labelled nav; sibling dimming on hover/focus
external links announce (opens in a new tab)
reduced motion renders a still field

content.brand: Fieldnote, production notes for teams of one to fifty
content.signOff: Production notes for teams of one to fifty. Written by people who still get paged.
content.links: Docs, Changelog, Pricing, Status, Careers, GitHub ↗

avoid: per-frame fillText across the whole grid
a wordmark touching the viewport edges
scrambling the whole field at rest
a sweep longer than about a second, or revealing the text as one block
code: pure helpers rasterise / buildField / drawReveal / drawLens / drawShimmer / drawCell; useLensPointer hook; thin AsciiField component; FIELD tuning object and T timeline
